itemListElement.name: Notion AI Note Taker Review 2026: How AI Meeting Notes Works for US Teams

mainEntity.name: Is the Notion AI note taker free?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. It comes with Business ($20 per member per month) and Enterprise, while Free and Plus get a limited trial. Two details the plan grid hides: eligible mobile subscriptions that bundle Notion AI include it too, and a workspace owner can switch AI Meeting Notes off for everyone.

mainEntity.name: How do I use Notion's AI note taker?

acceptedAnswer.text: Type /meet on a page in the desktop app, click Start transcribing, then Stop. Notion writes the summary into the page, and you can click Resume transcription to carry on. Agenda notes typed under Notes before the call feed into the summary, and uploads work too: AAC, M4A, MP3 and WAV, but not MP4 or MOV.

mainEntity.name: Does Notion AI take meeting notes without a bot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, no bot joins: Notion records your system audio and mic through the desktop app. It even notices when another app is using your microphone and offers to take notes, a prompt you can turn off under Settings, Notifications. Nothing is captured unless you start it.

mainEntity.name: Can Notion transcribe Zoom and Google Meet calls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, through the desktop app. Two gotchas: in a browser, conferencing audio is lost if you wear headphones, and on a virtual desktop Notion hears only your mic unless IT installs its local plugin. For Google Meet, a Chrome add-on brings speaker labels to group calls.

mainEntity.name: Is Notion's note taker better than Granola?

acceptedAnswer.text: Notion suits teams already on Business who want notes beside their docs. Granola costs $14 against $20 and adds pre-meeting briefs and follow-up emails on its paid tier, neither of which Notion lists. Granola Basic keeps only 30 days of history, though, while Notion notes stay as pages.

mainEntity.name: Does Notion's AI note taker support Hindi?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hindi is not among the 16 languages Notion's help center lists as of October 2026. Lynkk covers Hindi and adds a Hinglish setting for mid-sentence switching, with Tamil, Telugu, Marathi and Bengali in beta.
